description: ElectroDynJax is the repository maintainers' JAX-based power-system simulator for differentiating through transient simulations. Its documented functions include RMS generator models, partitioned EMT inverter coupling, disturbances, protection events and batched scenarios. Inputs are network cases, initial states, component parameters and events; outputs are trajectories and computed sensitivities that can support parameter fitting or control optimisation. Spatial coverage follows the configured IEEE test network; temporal resolution and duration are configurable. Source is free under MIT, with Python installation and quick-start examples. A limitation is that automatic-differentiation results still depend on the numerical scheme and model assumptions; performance and validation claims in the README were not independently reproduced. The package can support research on power-system stability and uncertainty. pandapower (model-pandapower) is a documented dependency. Optional language-agent functions are not required for the core simulator. No model weights, datasets or executable environment were downloaded.
name: ElectroDynJax differentiable power-system simulator
